# Research-grade analysis for business decisions.

::: {.lead}
WWGD applies the tools of academic economics, including causal inference, econometrics and machine learning, to operational and strategic questions, backed by years of market and competitive intelligence work for CBC/Radio-Canada, Corby Spirit & Wine and M-Brain's corporate clients.
:::
